passive.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
passive.tooltip:
Veigar's Abilities grant him @dAbilityStacks@ stack of Phenomenal Evil when they strike enemy champions. Takedowns on champions grant an additional @dTakedownStacks@ stacks.

Each stack of Phenomenal Evil grants Veigar @APPerStack@ Ability Power.

spells.name: Baleful Strike
spells.tooltip:
Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to the first two enemies hit.

If Veigar kills an enemy with this Ability, he gains @Spell.VeigarPassive:dQKillStacks@ stack of Phenomenal Evil. Large minions and large monsters grant @Spell.VeigarPassive:dQKillStacksLarge@ stacks instead.

spells.name: Dark Matter
spells.tooltip:
Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Every @Spell.VeigarPassive:PStacksPerDarkMatterCDR@ stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @Spell.VeigarPassive:DarkMatterCDRIncrement*100@%.

spells.name: Event Horizon
spells.tooltip: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that <status>Stuns</status> enemies that pass through for @StunDuration@ seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Primordial Burst
spells.tooltip: Veigar blasts an enemy champion with primal magic to deal between <magicDamage>@MinDamage@ and @MaxDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, increasing with the target's missing Health. Damage is maximized against enemies below 33% Health.
